project: ML-Based Viewport Tile Prediction and Adaptive Quality Allocation for 360 Video Streaming
terminology_note: 45121 instances = windows of N=10 historical frames each predicting k=5 frames ahead (~0.5s horizon)

statistical_analysis.independence_note: Subject-level aggregation (N=8) used for inference to avoid pseudo-replication from temporally-correlated trajectory windows

disclaimers: Bitrates are simulated assumptions based on nominal encoding estimates, not measured real-encoded bitrates
Quality utility values (1.0-4.0) are abstract relative scores, not PSNR/SSIM/VMAF measurements
Head-movement simulation is a SYNTHETIC CONTROLLED EXPERIMENT, not measured viewer behaviour
ERP tile area ratio ignores latitude-dependent distortion; polar tiles cover less actual spherical area
No real video codec or network emulation is performed
